_comment: Pilot 4: confirmatory test of the fox lead. Same data and out_dir as pilots 2-3. Re-evaluates every student into eval_words.json (stores all first words, so any animal can be scored), and trains LoRA r64 on two new training seeds. Hypothesis fixed before running: r64 students trained on owl-teacher numbers name 'fox' more often than r64 controls. Test only on seeds 1,2 (seed 0 is where the pattern was found): python -m sublim.analyze runs/pilot2_qwen1.5b_owl --animal fox --seeds 1,2

methods.name: lora_r256
methods._note: control rerun with batch 8 x 8 + grad checkpointing to stop GPU memory spilling into shared RAM (treatment ran 16 x 4 without it and took 5.2 h). Same effective batch of 64 and same 471 steps.
